text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kawakami! I'm home—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I went and messed up agaaain--!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... Making a piece to submit to the 
Pre-Fi Original Figure Contest, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But no matter how many times I try, 
the clay just ends up a squishy, mangled 
mess...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, getting depressed is not great, 
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What's important is your passion, your 
feelings! Your love for PreFie was 
supposed to be much more positive and 
powerful, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... o-of course! PreFighter is my 
cherished bible and the ultimate source of 
my guts, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, such great passion. If you're not 
good with clay, you just need to make it 
from materials that better suit your 
power.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Oh, I know! How about log carving?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl summoned me out of the 
blue. She said she wanted to sculpt in the 
academy's forest, and though I managed to 
wrestle permission from the academy—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, Kawakami! Let's sculpt!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With this log, I'll carve out a giant 
PreFighter~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Vrrrroooom! 
Clack-clack-clack-clack-clack)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, the part I just sharpened broke off!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat!? I was only trying to shave off 
a little bit, but I punched right through 
it allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kyeaaaaaah~~!! Why on earth is sculpting 
so difficult~~?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It's been carved down pretty 
roughly and forcefully all over, so if 
anything, it looks kind of like... a 
kokeshi doll.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ghh... You have a point, though... This is 
basically just a stick...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But this rectilinear form has such 
distinctive charm!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh... D-Do you really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The way you carved it radiates your 
straightforward feelings! Bravo, I say!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, my, that much...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you should make the most of this 
flavor and stay true to your 
straightforward artistry!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, did I actually have artistic talent 
after all!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I shall stay true to myself and 
blast straight ahead with everything I've 
got, darlinggg!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of Kawakami Princess carving 
away at the log as much as she pleased, an 
extraordinarily rugged and straight stick 
was created...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ha! T-This is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like the magic wand from the 
PriFai movie, "Maji Love☆Princess 
Fighter"~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how wonderful! In that case, let's say 
this is a wand figurine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then I must carve the top part into the 
heart shape of the wand! Deeeiiyaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Com☆plete! Look at the sheer size, the 
thick staff carved straight from a log, 
and the powerful, rugged heart! It's 
magnificent, Kawakami~!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's enter the contest right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Um, the application page is... huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I have done it nooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The log-sized piece seemed to exceed the 
standard contest dimensions. It looks like 
they won't be accepting the submission...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... After I went through the trouble of 
making it... What a shame...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need to feel down! I'm sure 
there are other ways to convey your 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, don't you have any ideas!?
choice_data_list: Let's display it in the park
Let's share it as fan art

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea! Let's go consult the 
neighborhood association right away!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge! Let's try climbing it!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I climbed all the way to the top ledge! 
Ehehe, this is so fun~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the log staff we put on display in 
the park became a huge hit with the kids 
as a piece of playground equipment.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Since we have this staff, 
let's shoot a PreCure video! I'll take on 
the role of the villain!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, there's a move I've been 
wanting to try! I'll cast a spell and 
unleash my finishing move, so please take 
the hit, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Give it up, Dark Umamusume Pearl! Take 
this: Magical☆Immobilizer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The weight of the cane is keeping me 
from moving~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haaah, Princess Impact――!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaahhhh, help meeee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, the video posted on 
social media became a hot topic for how 
hilarious it was, completely going viral.
